mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (user_id, token, expiry_time, used, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{token}, #{expiryTime}, #{used}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token, expiry_time, used, created_at, used_at FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE token = #{token} AND used = false AND expiry_time > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE expiry_time < UTC_TIMESTAMP() OR used = true
